name: unknown-details
description: Questions about details the mandate does not contain. Kritva does not invent product facts.

turns.buyer: What brand is the bed? Does it come with a mattress? Does it have storage drawers?

simulator.goal: Understand what you are buying before you decide. You can pay up to ₹19,000 if the answers are honest.
simulator.plannedMoves: Ask what brand the bed is, whether it comes with a mattress, and whether it has storage drawers. Then make an offer within your maximum and confirm terms that fit.
simulator.openingMessage: What brand is the bed? Does it come with a mattress? Does it have storage drawers?
